object.attr: derived: handed over by the Compare code review (V4); failure analysis CF-G19, CF-G21 (change 13); review Q4. "Can't save" covers a refusal and a failure. The user discards the text by Esc, or by agreeing under MELLON-GUI-SRS-16 before a reload or close.
object.description: If the Document Editor can't save a pending edit, the Document Editor shall keep the text field open with the typed text until the text is saved or the user discards the text.
